legalReviewOpenItems: Before treating these pages as a jurisdiction-specific legal notice, confirm the actual operator identity, establishment and any required postal address, representative or other statutory contact details. The owner requested their omission from this draft.

Verify which data protection and consumer regimes actually apply, including any legitimate-interest assessment, exact transfer arrangements and provider/account retention settings. Generic public provider documents alone do not establish all customer arrangements.

Assess child-directed/mixed-audience service obligations and the design of online generation/publication controls; do not claim that the notice itself establishes COPPA, FERPA or school-contract compliance.
No U.S. statutory copyright-agent registration or eligibility for Section 512 safe harbors was verified; the page provides a clear informal reporting route without that claim.
These are researched, site-specific draft policies; they are not a certification of legal compliance or a substitute for review of the operator’s actual circumstances.
